title: Ozi routing intelligence: spoke-profile-aware dispatch + proactive cross-spoke suggestions
description: When dispatching to multiple spokes, Ozi reads each spoke's profile (focus, audience, purpose) from hub registry and drafts tailored messages. Proactive suggestions surface only for impact >= 8 completions. Ask-once protocol for missing profiles. Trivial work is silent. Depends on hub registry spoke profiles + teams. Captured in lug-routing-intelligence-20260330.
